name: Finish the book
summary: Finish your book draft with weekly word targets and a stop rule that keeps revision from stalling the draft.
duration: Set by your deadline, often 12 to 26 weeks

onboarding.prompt: Target word count for the draft?
onboarding.reaction: That's a whole book. Let's slice it.

onboarding.prompt: When do you want the draft done?
onboarding.reaction: Deadline set. Weekly targets come next.

onboarding.prompt: Tap your writing slots on those days.

phases.name: Draft
benchmarks: Weekly word target hit most weeks
actions: Revision stop rule: no rewriting earlier chapters until the draft is done; notes go in a fix-later list

plan_blueprint.calendar: Writing sessions on the chosen days and slots, a weekly word-count check, and the draft deadline.

approach_variants.habit: Write at the same time each writing day; session streak.
approach_variants.willpower: Weekly word sprints and a countdown to the draft deadline.
approach_variants.time: Each session is a calendar block; weekly review of time written.
approach_variants.resource: First week sets up the writing space, tools and a reader or two.

guardrails: Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: Missed words roll gently across the next two weeks rather than piling onto one day. After a missed month, the plan offers a new deadline or a lower weekly target.
